metadata.title: Velocity Dispersion Profile of the Milky Way Halo

notes: No eligible individual stars can be listed. The paper discusses unbound HVSs only collectively: the Fig. 2 caption states that positive velocity outliers with v_rf > +400 km s−1 are the unbound HVSs (T:p2-b8), and the text reports 18 stars with v_rf > +300 km s−1 called the HVSs (T:p3-b2), but the supplied material gives no individual names, source IDs, or unique coordinates for them. The three confirmed young main-sequence B stars with v_rf > +400 km s−1 are also not individually identified (T:p4-b5). The partial Table A1 (T:p8-b0; I:p8-b0) identifies none of its rows as unbound candidates. The one individually singled-out star, the radial-velocity variable near −300 km s−1, was excluded from the halo sample and is not identified as an unbound candidate (T:p7-b2).
